eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ICICAI-2026), organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at GGITS, Jabalpur, and sponsored by IEEE Madhya Pradesh Section, focuses on advancements in intelligent computing and AI. The conference covers emerging areas such as machine learning, deep learning, and robotics, while promoting interdisciplinary collaboration to address real-world challenges. Discussions will include theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications across sectors like healthcare and agriculture, with an emphasis on ethics and responsible AI use. It features keynote talks, technical sessions, and networking opportunities to foster innovation and impactful research.
